title: Medical English 07-08
category: Medical & Dental Questions > Medical English Question

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is the correct example of 'past perfect continuous tense'?
options: The train had started before I reached the station
We have been living here for five years.
What was she doing in the last evening?
At that time Shama had been writing a novel for two months.
questions.explanation: Past perfect continuous tense-এর structure হচ্ছে sub + had been + verb + ing + extension.

questions.question: Which of the followings is the correct 'direct form' of this sentence: 'Columbus wanted to know whether any of them could make an egg stand on end.'
options: Columbus said to them, 'Can any of you made an egg stand on end?'
Columbus said to them, 'Can any of you make a egg stand on end?"
Columbus said to them, 'Can any of you make an egg stand on end?"
Columbus said to them, 'Can any of you make an egg stood on end?'
questions.explanation: Causative verb 'make'-এর পরে base form (stand) হয় আর egg-এর আগে an বসে

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is having the word 'like' as adjective?
options: Do not talk like that
We shall not see his like again
Children like sweets
They are men of like build and stature
questions.explanation: Option A তে, like শব্দটি verb (talk) কে modify করছে তাই এটা adverb; option B তে, like শব্দটি see verb এর object হিসেবে বসেছে অর্থাৎ, noun এর কাজ করছে; option D তে like শব্দটি build (গড়ন, কাঠামো) & stature (উচ্চতা) noun দুটিকে modify করায় like এখানে adjective এর কাজ করছে; এবং option C তে like শব্দটি verb হিসেবে বসেছে। সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর D.

questions.question: Which of the followings is a correct English sentence?
options: I am related with her by marriage
He is very popular with his pupils
I prefer coffee than tea
Death is preferable than dishonor
questions.explanation: Prefer/preferable এর পর কখনও than বসে না, to বসে। Related to হয়, তবে popular + with হয়।

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is not having appropriate preposition?
options: I shall come back within an hour.
She climbed over the fence.
Raise your arms above your head
He walked across the stage
questions.explanation: Raise-এর পরে over থাকলে বাক্যের অর্থ যথাযথ হবে

questions.question: Which of followings is the correct 'indirect form' of this sentence: The teacher said, "Mohsin is good and kind and he helps everyone."
options: The teacher say that Mohsin was good and kind and he helped everyone.
The teacher said that Mohsin was good and kind and he helped everyone
The teacher said that Mohsin is good and kind and he helped everyone
The teacher said that Mohsin was good and kind and he help everyone.
questions.explanation: Reporting verb past হওয়ায় Reported speech present থেকে past form-এ রুপান্তরিত হয়েছে

questions.question: Which of the followings is a superlative sentence?
options: He declared that he was innocent
Foreign travel is more pleasant than most other things.
They saw that the drunken porter was lying on the floor.
Hamlet is one of the most popular dramas
questions.explanation: One of the most-এটা superlative degree-এর structure |

questions.question: Which of the followings is not the appropriate bangla?
options: Exorcise: প্রমোদ ভ্রমণ
Emigrate দেশত্যাগ করা
Envious: ঈর্ষাপরায়ণ
Exhort: উপদেশ দ্বারা উৎসাহিত করা
questions.explanation: Exorcise অর্থ খারাপ প্রেতাত্মা বা ভূত তাড়ানো।

questions.question: Which of the followings will not be the proper replacement of the bracket word in this sentence: Shaheed Dr. Shamsuzzoha is considered to be the first (intellectual) who attained martyrdom during the pre-liberation period of Bangladesh.'
options: wise person
academic
scholarly
practical
questions.explanation: intellectual শব্দের অর্থ বুদ্ধিজীবী, জ্ঞানী। এর কিছু সমার্থক শব্দ: wise person, scholarly, academic, cognitive etc.। অন্যদিকে, practical অর্থ ব্যবহারিক, বাস্তবিক। Intellectual এর সাথে এর কোনো সম্পর্ক নেই।

questions.question: Which of the following pairs is not correct? (Adjectives-Verb)
options: weak - weakly
false - falsify
able - enable
sure - ensure

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is the correct example of 'participle adjective'?
options: The setting sun has gilded the hill top
She carried a lighted candle in her hand
The axe-man has hewed down the tree
She has lighted a candle
questions.explanation: Verb এর সাথে ing যুক্ত অংশ যখন adjective এর কাজ করে তখন তাকে participle adjective বলে। Setting (set + ing) বাক্যে, sun (noun) কে modify করায় এটা adjectivel

questions.question: Which of the followings is the correct English translation of this Bangla Sentence? 'অন্যেরা তাদের বিছানা ছেড়ে ওঠার আগেই সকালে ঘুম থেকে ওঠা ব্যক্তি তার কঠিন কাজের বেশির ভাগই শেষ করে ফেলে।'
options: The early riser has done a large quantity of hard work before other man had got out of bed.
The early riser has done large quantity of hard work before men have got out of bed.
The early riser has done a large quantity of hard work before other men have got out of bed.
The early riser has done a large quantity of hard work before other man have got out of bed
questions.explanation: Other + plural noun + have হয়। অর্থাৎ, A ও D ভুল। B-তে other শব্দটিই নেই। বাক্যে, 'অন্যেরা' বহুবচন বা plural sense প্রকাশ করছে। তাই এর ইংরেজি অর্থ হবে other men এবং এরপর plural verb (have) হবে।

questions.question: Which of the followings is the correct English translation of this Bangla sentence? 'পাতাগুলো যখন ঝরে পড়বে তখন গাছগুলো ভিন্ন রূপ দেখাবে।'
options: The trees will looks different when the leaves have fallen off.
The trees will look different when the leaves have fallen off.
The trees would look different when the leaves have fallen off.
The trees will look different when the leaves had fallen off
questions.explanation: Future-এ সংঘটিত দুটি কাজের মধ্যে একটি present perfect হলে অন্যটি future simple হবে

questions.question: Which of the followings is the correct conversion of this compound sentence to simple sentence using a prepositional phrase 'He was terribly unhappy, but he did not blame the girl.'
options: In spite off being terribly unhappy, he did not blamed the girl.
In spite in being terrible unhappy, he did not blame the girl.
In spite on being terribly unhappy, he do not blame the girl
In spite of being terribly unhappy, he did not blame the girl
questions.explanation: Compound sentence এ, but থাকলে simple sentence এ রূপান্তরের সময় in spite of + phrase অথবা despite + phrase বসে। বাক্যটির বাংলা অর্থ খুবই অসুখী থাকা সত্ত্বেও, সে বালিকাটিকে দোষারোপ করেনি।

questions.question: Which of the followings is not the correct affirmative sentence?
options: You are very fortunate
The first day in Dieppe is very exciting
How big they are!
He was the only man alive on a wide sea
questions.explanation: How + adjective দিয়ে শুরু হয়ে note of exclamation (!) দিয়ে শেষ হলে সেটি exclamatory sentence হয়
